caption: Understanding how the locked state operates requires knowing broker API limitations. Except at Dhan, no broker-level block trading API exists. When your account enters a LOCKED state, enforcement relies on a server-side re-fire loop that squares off trades within seconds rather than preventing them outright. When a breach happens, KaatDo cancels every pending order, squares off every position at market, keeps the account locked until close, and re-fires if trading activity reappears. kaatdo.com काट दो. KaatDo is not investment advice and is not registered with SEBI. Broker API execution is never guaranteed. #KaatDo #KillSwitch #ServerSide #TradingDiscipline #RiskManagement #FandO #TradingTools
